environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789012:regional/webacl/prod-api-acl/abc123) with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in COUNT mode for logging, (2) Priority 1: Custom rate-based rule limiting to 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, action BLOCK, (3) Priority 2: Custom rule group 'prod-api-custom-rules' containing a regex match rule on query string values matching pattern (?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|xp_) with action BLOCK and text transformation URL_DECODE applied before matching, (4) Priority 3: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode (monitoring only, not blocking). The WebACL default action is ALLOW.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL attached
config.waf_rule_priority_1: Rate-based rule: 100 req/5min per IP, BLOCK
config.waf_rule_priority_2: Custom regex on query string values: (?i)('|--|;|union\s|select\s|insert\s|drop\s|update\s|exec\s|xp_) with URL_DECODE transform, action BLOCK
